name: After § 77
title: REPORT on the implementation of the common foreign and security policy – annual report 2025
part_text: 77b. Supports a peaceful democratic transition in Venezuela; acknowledges the present threats to the stability of the country after 25 years under a dictatorial regime; acknowledges the courage and leadership demonstrated by Edmundo González Urrutia and María Corina Machado in their fight for freedom and democracy for the Venezuelan people;
